receipt.reasoning_summary: Sums gross base/overtime/extra-shifts/bonus, and separately sums NetPayable into Paid or Outstanding based on IsPaid. Gross can exceed the sum of net buckets because deductions are not included in Earned. Long accumulators have no explicit overflow guard. No production report caller had been verified by the author.

source_semantics.earned: For every tuple, adds Base.Piastres + Overtime.Piastres + ExtraShifts.Piastres + Bonuses.Piastres, irrespective of IsPaid. This is gross earning-component sum, not net payroll liability or net cash paid.
source_semantics.paid: Adds NetPayable.Piastres only when IsPaid is true.
source_semantics.outstanding: Adds NetPayable.Piastres only when IsPaid is false. Each row enters exactly one of Paid/Outstanding buckets.
source_semantics.rounding_and_floor: No rounding or zero-floor occurs in this helper; inputs are long-piastres Money values. Caller-supplied negative NetPayable would flow through as a negative paid/outstanding amount. The intended PayrollLine producer CalculatePayrollLines floors ordinary negative net to zero, but no current production caller of PayrollReport was found.
source_semantics.numeric_limits: The per-line gross sum and aggregate accumulators are long arithmetic with no explicit checked block or overflow guard in this method. Extreme-value behavior was not executed or asserted.
